## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #363 fixes #361, where Codex-backed Sepo runs could detect `OPENAI_API_KEY` but still fail ACPX session authentication because ACPX expects `ACPX_AUTH_<METHOD_ID>` variables.
- The PR extracts shared runtime environment construction into `.agent/src/runtime-env.ts`.
- It mirrors Sepo’s OpenAI input into `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ACPX_AUTH_OPENAI_API_KEY`, and `ACPX_AUTH_CODEX_API_KEY`.
- It also adds focused runtime-env tests and updates the provider credential docs.
- The implementation direction matches the issue, but the current PR head fails the required `Test Scripts` check.

## Review
The core fix is sound, and the docs/rubrics review do not show required rework. However, the current head `063477b5` fails CI because existing contract tests still expect moved env wiring to live directly in `run.ts`. One reviewer treated this as minor coverage drift, but the live failed check confirms it is blocking.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Existing env contract tests still target `run.ts` | BLOCKING | `Test Scripts` fails two `envelope.test.ts` tests because `INPUT_SECONDARY_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` assertions were not updated after moving the shared env builder into `runtime-env.ts`. |

## Progress
- Confirmed PR #363 closes #361 and no broader parent/tracking issue was referenced beyond the orchestrated issue flow.
- Rubrics review passed with no rubric-specific blockers.
- Existing PR discussion and inline review state were checked; there were no prior inline comments or review threads before synthesis.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/src/runtime-env.ts` line 29: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/363#discussion_r3321191195.
- No threads were resolved, no comments were minimized, and no replies were added.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Existing env contract tests still target `run.ts`</summary>

**Cause:** The PR moved `buildSharedEnv()` from `.agent/src/run.ts` into `.agent/src/runtime-env.ts`, but `.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts` still reads `run.ts` and asserts that secondary-token and reasoning-effort env wiring appears there. The live `Test Scripts` run fails on `shared run-agent-task exposes an optional secondary GitHub token` and `run-agent-task maps reasoning effort for Claude env and Codex thought level`.

**Candidate solutions:** Update the old source-contract assertions to inspect `runtime-env.ts`, or better, add direct `buildSharedEnv()` behavioral coverage in `.agent/src/__tests__/runtime-env.test.ts` for `INPUT_SECONDARY_GITHUB_TOKEN`, `MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`, while preserving the action/workflow wiring checks in `envelope.test.ts`.

**Comments:** This is not a design objection to the extraction. It is a required test update because the current PR head has a failing required check.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The unresolved issue is a concrete branch change that should update the moved env-contract tests and make the full `npm test` suite green.

## Final Verdict
NEEDS_REWORK

## Action Items
- [ ] Update the env contract tests so secondary-token and reasoning-effort wiring are asserted against `buildSharedEnv()` / `runtime-env.ts`, and ensure the full test suite passes.
